LanguageData.SSC_Emitter_ToggleDesc: Switch this device directly. No pawn is needed. Turning it off stops new exposure; existing drug effects wear off normally.
LanguageData.SSC_Emitter_RadiusDesc: Adjust the radius in whole cells (5–20). Power demand is 100 + 4 × radius² W. Coverage is limited to the same room. Exposure rate per target is unchanged.
LanguageData.SSC_Emitter_PowerDesc: Power demand depends on the selected radius. Turning the device off draws no power.
